thread:
elaine: Quick sync: we have mixed `model` vs `model_name` in docs and ambiguous use of "latency". Proposal: use `model` in public SDK examples, keep `model_name` for DB/schema docs, and use "response latency" when referring to end-to-end measurements.

mike: I can update JS/Py snippets and add a note in examples/README. Will mark legacy schema usage in comments using the word "legacy" (not deprecated).

samira: Agree. Please avoid "deprecated" in examples unless we have a formal deprecation plan. I'll review wording for customer-facing pages.

toni: I'll add a one-line glossary entry and a tiny voice note: "Use concise, neutral phrasing; avoid promotional language."

docs-bot: New PR opened by mike: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4801 - "SDK snippet parity: model -> model_name harmonization"

elaine: Two quick checks before merge: docs owner review (samira) and a short tone pass by me. If both green we merge today and post a short note in #release-notes. :thumbsup:
